 Is Sirius XM Holdings (SIRI) Cheap Based On Future Cash Flow?
 October 28, 2026 SI Simply Wall St Reviewed by Bailey Pemberton Sirius XM Holdings has delivered a strong rebound over the past year, which puts fresh attention on a different question. Are investors now paying a price that its future cash flows can reasonably support, based on what the business currently generates and reinvests?
 Over 5 years the share price has fallen 47.7%, which raises the issue of whether the cash the business can produce still lines up with where the stock trades today.
 The subscription driven model can translate relatively stable listener relationships into recurring cash generation, which matters for how much value those future streams may justify right now.
 What if you looked at Sirius XM Holdings through its earnings instead? See what Sirius XM Holdings's 10.4x P/E says about the price .
 The stock's next move may depend on whether the cash flows investors expect from Sirius XM Holdings are strong and reliable enough to support the current share price.
 If you are weighing Sirius XM Holdings through the lens of its cash generation, it can help to compare that picture against other companies screened for 29 high quality undervalued stocks .
 Advertisement Does Sirius XM Holdings Look Undervalued on Cash Flow?
 The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model here focuses on the cash that Sirius XM Holdings can send to shareholders over time. Latest twelve month free cash flow sits at about $1.47b, and the projections used in the DCF assume that this stream broadly grows from that base rather than shrinking away.
 What really matters is how that cash picture compares with the trading level. On these assumptions, the DCF projections put Sirius XM Holdings' estimated intrinsic value substantially above the current share price of $27.25. That suggests the market is pricing the business on more cautious cash flow expectations than the model. This is why it can be useful to see the detailed assumptions behind that gap before deciding how persuasive this valuation feels to you.
